correctness.rationale: In a product of fields, annihilators are coordinate ideals supported on support complements. The Badawi adjacency condition is therefore exactly incomparability of supports. Every comparable pair has an explicit common incomparable support, so all nonedges have distance two. The edge count follows from a weighted three-state coordinate enumeration with inclusion-exclusion; substitution simplifies exactly to the displayed product formula. Independent finite replay matches all formulas.

value.rationale: The 2022 survey explicitly identifies annihilator graphs as a Wiener-index target. The theorem resolves the complete finite commutative semisimple family, gives the full distance enumerator rather than only a single scalar invariant, and shows exactly how field sizes enter through four multiplicative factors. This is a natural infinite ring family rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
